newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse closes up 3.0 percent, banks rally.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse closes up 3.0 percent, banks rally.

text.p: Greek stocks climbed 3.0 percent on Monday on strong volume with market watchers saying momentum was strong and rallying bank stocks had more to go on the upside.

"The market is still rallying with shares that had already risen, such as banks as some investors expect a further rise of the index to 1,200 points and are entering the market," said Nikos Kostopoulos, analyst at Commercial Securities.
National Bank is a leader in its sector, with the highest percentage increase in profits and lowest P/E and forecasts for a good performance in 1997, he said.
OTE shares, at 5,190, have not surpassed their recent peak of 5,390 on January 20, he added.
Shares of Intracom could rise on Tuesday if Intracom's joint venture with Siemens ends up in the signing of a contract with OTE, for an order of more than 300,000 digital switches, he said.
He expected the bank rally to continue and be followed by construction shares.
"The next resistance level could be 1,200 points. If on Tuesday we see an increase in both the index and volume, we are in for a sustained bull market," he added.
Another analyst expected the bullish trend to continue for the whole year and said banks had more upside potential.
"Shares of private banks will continue to rally as they are cheap, with high dividends and good profits," said an analyst at Eurocorp S.A. investment consultants.
The Athens general share index closed up 3.0 percent or 32.82 points higher at 1125.13 from Friday's 1092.31, after opening at 1093.94.

Most sectoral indices ended higher with banks gaining 4.97 percent, construction rising 4.36 percent and investment shares ending 2.75 percent. Small caps ended 0.94 percent down but industrials gained 1.65 percent.
Monday's turnover was 12.4 billion drachmas on volume of 4.7 million shares. Gainers led losers 125 to 85 with 31 issues unchanged on 241 traded.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas was quoted higher at 854.00-872.00. Shares of OTE telecom the underlying, rose 70 drachmas to close at 5,190.

The recently launched ING Baring Financial Products American style call warrant based on a basket of six bank stocks was quoted higher at $18.96-$19.96. The strike price is set at $99.60 and the warrants expire October 8, 1997.
The Morgan Stanley Hellenic Blue Chip Warrant, which has a strike price of 100 marks, was quoted higher at 7,071-7,508 drachmas.
